text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky invites me down to the hotel
resort
for their soft opening event.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
This place is popping off! Let's do a

hundred-square human shogi contest! I'll
be the
king, and you can be a
charismatic beautician!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I heard they renovated the place, but I
don't see
any changes.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky might be their ambassador,
but this is
looking to be a letdown. Was
she cajoled into the
role?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Maruzen isn't the type to—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hi, everybody! And welcome to this
off-the-road
paradise resort!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Without any further ado, I would like to
present
the special new service we've
concocted for the
hotel's renewal. We
call it...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The "Be a Noble for a Day" experience!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And so, we've prepared a personal
butler for
every guest! ♪

text_block_list.name: Butler
text_block_list.text:
<username>, I will
be
accompanying you for the day. Let
me know if
you have any requests.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's start off with the spa! The steam
will melt
away your built-up fatigue. ♪

text_block_list.name: Butler
text_block_list.text:
How do you find the water? Would you
like any
refreshments?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you just read my mind! Get me
some oden
broth, and put some of those
cold blocks in it so
the glass will go
"cling cling"!

text_block_list.name: Butler
text_block_list.text: Understood. Coming right up.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Well, this is nothing special. Any
establishment
could provide the same
service if they wanted to.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And now for some delicious afternoon
tea! This
luxurious room will have you
feeling like one of
the elites.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The absence of a tea stand makes this
experience
feel quite authentic!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And I do appreciate the attention to
detail with
these matching tea cups and
silverware!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the gracious compliment.
In fact,
our establishment's teatime was
once featured in
a novel written during
the Taisho era.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! This place was mentioned in that

masterpiece?! Who knew I would ever
get the
chance to experience the flavors
described in that
text...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, time for a photo shoot! Pick
out your
dress of choice and accessories
from this
wonderful closet!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's hard to choose when they all
look so
great! I guess I could say a
well-made dress
outshines even the
softest paw!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I get it. In our modern age, rarely do we
get the
chance to dress in such formal
wear, making this
experience all the
more fresh... Um, how many
participants
are allowed?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Be a Noble for a Day
experience
comes to an end.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And that's the last of it! I'll let the
manager do the
closing honors!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
I would like to thank everyone for
coming. In
today's landscape of
ever-changing trends, our
resort could
appear outdated to some.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
But I firmly believe that while the times
may
change, people's hearts are
unchanging.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
What captures the heart is neither
innovation nor
nostalgia. The important
thing is...

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
Authenticity. It's about staying true to
yourself
and honing your strengths.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
That is what drives us to provide our
vision of
quality service.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Believing in your heart, and striving to
reach out
with it...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I hope that today's experience allowed
you to
feel the great pride and passion
each member of
this hotel's staff holds.

text_block_list.name: All the Staff
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for joining us today. We hope
that
you'll choose us for your next trip!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I have to say, that was marvelous! The
staff's
passion and the history of this
place really shines
through... My heart
feels a little lighter, strangely
enough.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I have to write a piece on this! I'll call it,
"Historic
Hotel Sees a Grand Revival."

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: Oh! Th-thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm readying myself to go home when I
spot
Maruzensky down by the shore.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whew... the breeze feels wonderful! I
can never
get enough of this beach.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The shoreline is long. It's tranquil... And
today, it
somehow looks more radiant
than usual.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll trust in my heart when it beats with

excitement. However old or outdated
the reason
may be.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What matters most to me is what's
trendy! Don't
you think? ♪
